fee_notes: Standard single-unit "Initial Franchise Fee" is $39,900. Reduced fees apply under specific circumstances: $29,900 for honorably discharged U.S. military veterans, first responders, or their spouses ("Veterans and First Responders Program"); $20,000 for existing franchisees in full compliance adding a second or additional new location; $10,000 for existing franchisees converting an existing independent business as a Conversion Franchise. Under a Multi-Unit Agreement, the fee is $39,900 for the first center, $20,000 for the second, and $15,000 for each additional center (minimum Multi-Unit Fee of $35,000). Discounts may not be combined. All initial fees are nonrefundable.
raw_excerpt:
The "Initial Franchise Fee" for a single Grease Monkey Center is $39,900. Each Franchise Agreement will grant you the right to operate one Grease Monkey Center.

We currently offer a reduced Initial Franchise Fee under the following circumstances:
1. ...the Initial Franchise Fee will be $20,000 for your second Grease Monkey Franchise and each additional Grease Monkey Franchise thereafter.
2. ...we offer a reduced Initial Franchise Fee of $10,000 for each such additional location that is open and operating and you convert to a Grease Monkey Center.
3. ...we offer a reduced Initial Franchise Fee of $29,900 for a single Grease Monkey Center ("Veterans and First Responders Program").
